risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seams, base, and all fittings.

risks.risk: The tanks may be empty, but the seller may not be able to prove the capacity or contents.
risks.proof: A photo of a weight scale showing the gross weight of the tanks.
risks.if_unproven: as empty and scrap value only
